title: 对比学习中的锚点散度与语义几何
summary: 本文研究语义上下文如何决定学习到的向量表示的几何结构。作者利用对比学习、指数族与信息几何之间的相互作用，建立了锚点概率分布与表示空间上Bregman几何之间的对应关系，并据此提出"锚点散度"方法，可在固定表示上指定特定上下文的语义几何。检索实验表明该方法能高效地指定上下文相关的语义相似度。
summary_en: This paper studies how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. Using an interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry, the authors establish a correspondence between probability distributions over anchors and Bregman geometries on the representation space, defining "Anchor Divergences" to specify context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations. Retrieval experiments show it effectively and efficiently specifies context-specific semantic similarity.
